_about: Curated CORDIS DET queries for Cluster 1 (Health) call subjects, keyed by the subject the tagger looks up (call topic_title where present, else the call title/name). Each query is contenttype=project with phrase-quoted, OR-grouped domain terms grounded in the cluster theme, drafted + adversarially verified to be bounded and on-topic (mirrors cluster_3.json). The tagger fetches each query, aggregates the funded projects' EuroSciVoc research fields, writes them onto the matching Call nodes, and links the calls to the projects (HAS_FUNDED_PROJECT). Edit freely; re-run POST /cordis/tag-calls {"source":"cluster_1"} to apply.
